sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Today I'd like to present the findings of our Year 2 project on wildlife found in gardens throughout our city.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想向大家介绍我们二年级项目关于本市花园中野生动物分布情况的调查结果。

sentences.en: I'll start by saying something about the background to the project, then talk a little bit about our research techniques, and then indicate some of our interim findings.
sentences.zh: 我将首先简要介绍该项目的背景，然后简单说明我们的研究方法，最后指出一些初步发现。

sentences.en: First of all, how did we choose our topic?
sentences.zh: 首先，我们是如何选定这一主题的？

sentences.en: Well, there are four of us in the group and one day while we were discussing a possible focus, two of the group mentioned that they had seen yet more sparrow-hawks - one of Britain's most interesting birds of prey - in their own city centre gardens and wondered why they were turning up in these gardens in great numbers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们小组共有四人，某天在讨论可能的研究方向时，组内有两人提到，他们在自己位于市中心的花园里又看到了更多雀鹰——英国最引人入胜的猛禽之一，并好奇为何这种鸟类会大量出现在这些城市花园中。

sentences.en: We were all very engaged by the idea of why wild animals would choose to inhabit a city garden.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都对‘野生动物为何会选择栖息于城市花园’这一想法深感兴趣。

sentences.en: Why is it so popular with wildlife when the countryside itself is becoming less so?
sentences.zh: 当乡村本身正日益失去对野生动物的吸引力时，城市花园为何却如此受其青睐？

sentences.en: The first thing we did was to establish what proportion of the urban land is taken up by private gardens.
sentences.zh: 我们做的第一件事是确定私人花园占城市土地总面积的比例。

sentences.en: We estimated that it was about one fifth, and this was endorsed by looking at large-scale usage maps in the town land survey office - 24% to be precise.
sentences.zh: 我们估算该比例约为五分之一，而通过查阅市土地调查办公室的大比例尺用地地图，这一估算得到了证实——精确值为24%。

sentences.en: Our own informal discussions with neighbours and friends led us to believe that many garden owners had interesting experiences to relate regarding wild animal sightings so we decided to survey garden owners from different areas of the city, Just over 100 of them completed a survey once every two weeks for twelve months - ticking off species they had seen from a pro forma list - and adding the names of any rarer ones.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们与邻居和朋友进行了非正式交流，发现许多花园主人曾有过关于野生动物目击的有趣经历，因此我们决定对来自本市不同区域的花园主人展开问卷调查：略超100名受访者在为期十二个月的时间里，每两周填写一次问卷，从预设物种清单中勾选所见种类，并补充记录任何较罕见的物种。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, we were doing our own observations in selected gardens throughout the city.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们也在本市若干选定的花园中开展自主观察。

sentences.en: We deliberately chose smaller ones because they were by far the most typical in the city.
sentences.zh: 我们特意选择了面积较小的花园，因为它们在本市最具代表性。

sentences.en: The whole point of the project was to look at the norm not the exception.
sentences.zh: 本项目的核心目标正是考察普遍现象，而非特例。

sentences.en: Alongside this primary research on urban gardens, we were studying a lot of books about the decline of wild animals in the countryside and thinking of possible causes for this.
sentences.zh: 除针对城市花园开展上述主要研究外，我们还广泛阅读了有关乡村野生动物数量锐减的书籍，并思考可能导致这一现象的种种原因。

sentences.en: So what did we find?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, so much that I just won't have time to tell you about here.
sentences.zh: 内容实在太多，我今天恐怕没有时间一一详述。

sentences.en: If you're interested in reading our more comprehensive findings, we've produced detailed www.TopSage.com graphic representations on the college web-site and of course any of the group would be happy to talk to you about them.
sentences.zh: 若您希望了解更全面的调查结果，我们已在学院网站www.TopSage.com上发布了详尽的图表化呈现；当然，小组任何成员也都非常乐意就此与您深入交流。

sentences.en: Just email us.
sentences.zh: 请随时发送电子邮件联系我们。

sentences.en: What we've decided to present today is information about just three species - because we felt these gave a good indication of the processes at work in rural and urban settings as a whole.
sentences.zh: 今天我们决定仅重点介绍三个物种的相关信息，因为我们认为这三种动物能很好地反映城乡环境中正在发生的整体生态过程。

sentences.en: The first species to generate a lot of interesting information was frogs.
sentences.zh: 第一个提供大量有趣信息的物种是青蛙。

sentences.en: And there was a clear pattern here they proliferate where there is suitable water.
sentences.zh: 此处呈现出清晰的规律：只要存在适宜的水源，青蛙便大量繁殖。

sentences.en: Garden ponds are on the increase, rural ponds are disappearing, leading to massive migration to the towns.
sentences.zh: 花园池塘数量持续增加，而乡村池塘却不断消失，从而引发大规模向城镇的迁徙。

sentences.en: Hedgehogs are also it finding it easier to live in urban areas - this time because their predators are not finding it quite so attractive to leave their rural environment, so hedgehogs have a better survival rate in cities.
sentences.zh: 刺猬同样发现城市环境更易生存——这次是因为其天敌并不太愿意离开乡村栖息地，因此刺猬在城市中的存活率更高。

sentences.en: We had lots of sightings, so all in all we had no difficulties with our efforts to count their numbers precisely.
sentences.zh: 我们获得了大量目击记录，因此在精确统计其数量方面毫无困难。

sentences.en: Our final species is the finest of bird singers, the song thrush.
sentences.zh: 我们最后介绍的物种是鸣禽中最杰出的歌手——歌鸫。

sentences.en: On the decline in the countryside, they are experiencing a resurgence in urban gardens because these days gardeners are buying lots of different plants which means there's an extensive range of seeds around, which is what they feed on.
sentences.zh: 尽管歌鸫在乡村地区数量持续下降，但在城市花园中却出现明显复苏，原因在于如今园丁们购买了大量不同种类的植物，从而提供了极为丰富的种子资源——而这正是歌鸫的主要食物来源。

sentences.en: Another factor is the provision of nesting places which is actually better in gardens than the countryside.
sentences.zh: 另一因素是筑巢场所的供给，而花园中此类场所的实际条件甚至优于乡村。

sentences.en: Hard to believe it, but it's true.
sentences.zh: 这听起来虽难以置信，但确为事实。

sentences.en: Incidentally, we discovered that a massive new survey on song thrushes is about to be launched, so you should keep an eye open for that.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，我们还发现一项针对歌鸫的全新大规模调查即将启动，敬请关注。

sentences.en: Now, I'd be happy to answer any questions you may have www.TopSage.com
sentences.zh: 现在，我很乐意回答各位提出的任何问题。www.TopSage.com
